⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Review for The Bark Park, Wishaw

The Bark Park is an absolutely fantastic space for dogs and their families. You can really tell it’s been designed with dogs’ safety and freedom in mind. With over an acre of secure, fully enclosed land, it gives dogs the chance to run, play, and explore completely off lead — stress free.

In a time when dog thefts and attacks are sadly on the rise in public parks, having a private, code-access park with 24-hour CCTV brings real peace of mind. It’s ideal for reactive dogs, nervous dogs, puppies, or simply anyone who wants a calm, safe walk without worrying about unexpected encounters.

The booking system is straightforward, the park is clean and well maintained, and the private time slots make it perfect for one-to-one walks, family visits, meet-ups with friends, or professional dog walkers looking for a secure environment.

A brilliant local facility that clearly comes from people who understand dogs and the realities of modern dog ownership. Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be back! 🐾
